Subject: Invoice delivery / e-invoice format question

Hi Mateo,

We're finishing our AP onboarding checklist and had a couple of quick questions about how Redwood can send invoices to Greenleaf. Our procurement team prefers machine-readable e-invoices (UBL/PEPPOL or XML) dropped to an SFTP feed, but we also need a human-readable PDF copy sent to accounts-payable@greenleaf-analytics.com for our internal scan-and-archive process.

Can you confirm which of the following you support out-of-the-box?
- SFTP push of UBL/UBL-UBL-like XML with a filename convention (we typically require GF-<PO>-<YYYYMM>.xml)
- Secure billing portal where invoices are available to download as XML+PDF (with an email notification)
- Email delivery as PDF (TLS) only

Also please include what VAT evidence you can provide (VAT number on invoice, VAT breakdown, and an exportable attachment that our tax team can ingest). We're in the EU (Italy) so the VAT presentation matters for our reconciliations.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement
Greenleaf Analytics


From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / e-invoice format question

Hi Elena,

Thanks — great questions and totally reasonable requirements. Redwood supports all three delivery patterns you listed; we can implement whichever fits your AP flow. Quick summary of options and pros/cons:

1) SFTP (recommended for automated ingestion)
- We can push UBL-style XML files to a secure SFTP location you provide (or we provision a folder for you on our SFTP host).
- Filenames can be templated (e.g., GF-<PO>-<YYYYMM>-INV-<INVNUM>.xml).
- We also include a matching PDF in the same folder for human review.
- Supports checksum and delivery receipts.

2) Billing portal (web + webhook)
- Invoices available via portal (XML and PDF).
- Optional webhook to notify your system when new invoices are published.
- Good if you want self-service history and downloads.

3) Email (TLS)
- PDF attachment emailed to accounts-payable address; can include XML as an attachment if required.
- Simpler, but less ideal for automated ingestion.

VAT/tax evidence:
- Every invoice contains our VAT (IT12345678901) and a line-by-line VAT breakdown.
- We can produce an XML-compatible tax summary file (redwood_einvoice_schema_v1.2.xml attached) and a small CSV export for bulk VAT reconciliation.

Attachments: sample XML schema and a sample PDF for GF-7123 (attached).

Next steps I propose:
1) Tell me which transmission mode you prefer (SFTP / Portal / Email + XML).
2) If SFTP: provide hostname/username/SSH key or tell us to provision a folder on our host (we then share credentials via a secure token).
3) Provide your AP contact + VAT number and the mandatory invoice reference format (if any).

If helpful I can loop in our Billing Ops team to handle provisioning — Laura Bennett handles SFTP and portal onboarding, and Marissa Cole runs day-to-day invoice formatting.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
